topic: The coverage gate passes without measuring a package whose tests fail
detail: scripts/cover.sh drops a package's profile when its tests fail and prints nothing about it, so 'make cover' can report every file at 80% or more while internal/daemon was never measured. SP-071's verifier hit this when TestResolveCost (a p99 per-connection latency test in internal/daemon) failed under load. Options: make cover.sh fail, or at least name the package, when a package's tests fail; loosen or isolate the latency test.
